notes.title: The Vintners v1.4.0
notes.content:
Greetings, winemakers! Our new major update is here!🍷

[b]New:[/b]

1. Vintner Mode: Begin your game with a blank slate, free of pre-planted fields, and shape your vineyard from the ground up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917011/4fdcc283877034f56587b2a0c4e54a7b280b688a.jpg[/img]

2. Demolish Function: You now have the ability to demolish vineyard blocks, giving you greater flexibility in managing your vineyard layout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917011/05c08628ed0f72b9e4cf671c035fa85214fe31e4.jpg[/img]

3. Trend Study: Hire marketing experts to analyze current trends and provide insights on this year's market preferences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917011/1dd3379ea52e3680f2d0d6bb83c2e20e3c98a4be.jpg[/img]

4.  Winery AC: Use the air conditioner control panel on the first floor to regulate the temperature within your winery.

Note: Now if the air conditioner is not turned on, the winery temperature will match the outside temperature. Please monitor the temperature carefully in summer and winter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917011/f76d147d308261ed7b6a9158d5958dfa2a97c240.jpg[/img]

5. Winemaking Codex: Access essential winemaking concepts and knowledge by pressing F1 in-game. The Glossary section of the Manual has also been relocated here. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917011/9e1e333ac077c6dddc844321d1914eeaeab3b2f4.jpg[/img]

[b]
Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the volume of the winery entry sound effect.
[*] Added a sound effect for contract signing.
[*] Vineyard blocks now display the age of the plants.
[*] You can now skip directly to just before the ceremony during the ceremony month.
[*] Cooling will automatically turn off once the vessel is emptied.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Skipping a month now properly incurs cooling fees.
[*] Fixed the issue where fruitset could occur twice within a vintage.
[*] Resolved the error that caused unexpected behaviors when planting grapes outside of winter.
[/list]

Cheers to all our supporting vintners. Happy winemaking!🍷

2. Demolish Function: You now have the ability to demolish vineyard blocks, giving you greater flexibility in managing your vineyard layout.
3. Trend Study: Hire marketing experts to analyze current trends and provide insights on this year's market preferences.
4. Winery AC: Use the air conditioner control panel on the first floor to regulate the temperature within your winery.
Note: Now if the air conditioner is not turned on, the winery temperature will match the outside temperature. Please monitor the temperature carefully in summer and winter.
5. Winemaking Codex: Access essential winemaking concepts and knowledge by pressing F1 in-game. The Glossary section of the Manual has also been relocated here.

notes.title: From Soil to Bottle is now available on Mac!
notes.content:
Greetings, winemakers!

We’re thrilled to announce that From Soil to Bottle is finally available for all Mac users! 

Along with this update, we've also made a few improvements:

[list]
[*] Added touchpad control for winery scrolling
[*] Implemented automatic saving before restarting the game when font size settings are changed
[*] Introduced a new resolution option for windowed mode
[*] Fixed map display and animation errors for resolutions with a ratio smaller than 1.77
[/list]

Unfortunately, the in-game bug reporting system is not available for Mac builds at the moment. We're working on this and will fix it in future updates ASAP.

Now let’s raise a glass to new beginnings and the art of winemaking! 🍷

notes.title: 🍇Under the vines v1.1.0
notes.content:
Greetings, winemakers! Our first major update has just been released!🍷

[b]New:[/b]
1. Sorting process. We can now sort grapes to remove unripe, disease-infected, and sunburned grapes to improve overall sugar content, reduce mouldy flavours, and enhance the overall flavour.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917011/94660925fa4d3d4f8e8b1f2b36f0f8816cc3fdf8.jpg[/img]
2. In-game leaderboard. Players can now view the leaderboard at any time by clicking the button on the main menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917011/9880a827e42565639602c9951d524f525ff28bd8.jpg[/img]
3. To better simulate the terroir, we introduced the local yeast, which will be randomly generated at the start of each game. As your vineyard matures, the wild yeasts on your grapes become more like the local yeast.
4. Now soil type also affects ripening speed. This difference arises from variations in soil temperature compared to air temperature.
[b]
Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] The operation of the cap management mini game has been improved. Caps are now easier to click, and when all 16 caps are plunged, the mini game automatically finishes.
[*] Adjusted the incidence of downy mildew. 
[*] Newly planted grapes now have lower amounts of everything, not just yield.
[*] Added sound effects for skipping mini games.
[*] Added visual feedback for different game speeds.
[*] Delayed the start time of wild yeast fermentation.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an error where creating a new game would not reset the vineyard block texture.
[*] Deleted an inaccurate line in the manual related to the reason for rotten egg occurrences.
[*] Fixed the bug when loading during animation would raise errors.
[*] Corrected a typo in the fermentation chart.
[*] Fixed a bug when skipping through months, sometimes the grape would not grow. 
[/list]
